text: A massive heavy beast slamming paws onto a weathered stone bridge. Immediate deep dry physical impact and loud brittle stone slab cracking at the very start, followed by a short cascade of uneven gravel and falling stone chips settling over one second. Weighty earthy crunch, organic rubble, detailed rocky debris. No metallic clang, no sword swoosh, no magic sparkle, no voice, no music, no distorted sub bass or explosion.
